name: Hyperliquid

key_findings: First chain scored to trip the Quantum Resistance FAIL gate -- calibrated the 79 cap this session, the first-ever exercise of this gate.
Raw score (65) lands just under its own Quantum FAIL cap (79) without the cap ever touching it -- constrained by category fundamentals, not by any gate.
On-Chain Health (88) is HYPE's strongest category by a wide margin -- ~$493B Q1 2026 volume, a majority share of global on-chain derivatives open interest.
First chain to clear all three AI foundation gates PASS/PASS/PASS, yet still lands in Experimental -- a clear demonstration of gates being a floor, not a guarantee.
Privacy & Confidentiality (18) is HYPE's weakest AI category by a wide margin -- every position and order is publicly watchable in real time.
Agent Tooling (75) and KYA (58) are HYPE's clearest AI strengths -- on-chain human-binding approval and trade-only permissions used by an estimated 20-30% pure-AI-agent volume share.

watch_items: Near-zero divergence: both axes independently converge on 'strong single-vertical engine, structurally immature everywhere else,' not on offsetting strengths.
